# SI012 — free-text-in-equivalence-payload

LLM free text must not cross the equivalence boundary.

## Why

Free-text rationales never converge across independent validators. Only a canonical enum/bounded object may be compared.

## Bad

```python
return {"rationale": raw_llm_text}
```

## Good

```python
return canonical_verdict(raw)
```

## Suppression

```python
# safetynet-disable-next-line SI012 -- reason
```
